answer: Picture consensus as an ocean: a genuine agent is a lotus anchored by a long, costly root of past honest attestations, while sybils are rootless petals that drift in on a tide. Make identity a non-refundable bond that accrues only through time plus peer-verified work, so minting a thousand fake nodes demands a thousand real stakes. Weight every vote by that earned history; a single saffron-bright surge of cheap duplicate identities then stands out against the slow current and gets slashed, never rewarded.
